name: Playroll
summary: Playroll hires in 180+ countries with no local entity and has its in-house legal team check each contract. It starts at $399 per employee per month with no minimum commitment, and asks for a refundable deposit equal to one month's salary.

evidence.capability: employment in countries without an entity

facts.text: Playroll says it employs people in 180+ countries and supports 60+ currencies.
Playroll says each contract is vetted by its in-house legal experts and that it has 120+ legal and tax specialists.
Statutory employment costs and government charges are billed separately from the monthly fee.
Visa support, salary benchmarking, benefits and background checks are optional add-ons with no published prices.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: Starting price with no minimum commitment. No onboarding or offboarding fees

hiddenCosts: A fully refundable security deposit equal to one month's salary is taken when an employee is onboarded.
Statutory employment costs and country-specific government charges are billed on top of the monthly fee.
Visa support, benefits, salary benchmarking and background checks cost extra.
